title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36192v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. Moreover, we observe similar but complementary gains from frozen bases and pixel decoding. These observations motivate Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD), which uses statistical knowledge both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks. WiD combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, with these components initialized with data statistics. translated_title: 超越估计：维纳信息引导解码以简化像素空间流模型的训练
translated_abstract: 直接在像素空间学习速度场既困难又缓慢。我们证明，粗粒度的二阶图像统计信息可以简化这一任务：冻结的维纳估计能够改进速度场的学习，且其收益超出了它们显式提供的线性预测。此外，我们观察到冻结基和像素解码也能带来类似但互补的收益。这些观察催生了维纳信息引导解码，它利用统计知识进行直接预测，并组织解码器的计算，而无需修改原生的模型模块。WiD 将一个可训练的维纳预测路径与系数接口相结合，后者将特征注入原生解码器并返回其预测的系数修正，这些组件均以数据统计量进行初始化。所有引入的参数，包括频谱和坐标变换，都在原始的像素空间速度目标下联合训练。在跨模型规模的多种设置中……
tldr: 提出维纳信息引导解码（WiD），利用二阶图像统计（维纳估计）来辅助速度场预测并组织解码器计算，从而显著简化像素空间流模型的训练。
en_tdlr: Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD) leverages coarse second-order image statistics to aid velocity prediction and organize decoder computation, making training of pixel-space flow models significantly easier.
